name: AXP Energy Limited
summary: AXP Energy Limited engages in the exploration and development of oil and gas assets in the United States. It holds 100% interest in the Pathfinder project covering an area of 15,282 acres in DJ Basin in Colorado. The company was formerly known as Austin Exploration Limited and changed its name to AXP Energy Limited in June 2017. AXP Energy Limited was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Florence, Colorado.
